report_name: Woodstock and Surrounding Areas Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify cycle desire lines by categorizing routes into primary, secondary, and local based on forecast flows of people cycling, using 2011 Census journey to work data as a guide supplemented by local knowledge.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool (RST) and Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP provides a prioritised list of interventions to guide future funding, including developer contributions and central government bids, and will be used to inform the update to the West Oxfordshire Local Plan 2041.
pct_usage_quote: The cycle desire line network, which shows the routes people use to cycle, regardless of whether they are currently suitable for cycling, have been identified using the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) (which uses 2011 Census journey to work data) and local knowledge.
